x[0] = N - 4
x[1] = 2
x[2] = 1
x[N - 4] = 1
and all other x[i] = 0.

For N = 16, this gives:
x[0] = 12
x[1] = 2
x[2] = 1
x[12] = 1
and x[i] = 0 for all other i.

We can verify this:
- 0 appears 12 times (at indices 3-11 and 13-15)
- 1 appears 2 times (at indices 2 and 12)
- 2 appears 1 time (at index 1)
- 12 appears 1 time (at index 0)
- All other numbers appear 0 times.
This perfectly matches the values in the sequence.
